text_block_list.text:
The Arima Kinen is the biggest race at
the end of
the year, gathering together
the best of the
classic and senior
athletes.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
In the paddock, Марузенски is
approached by an
Umamusume who has,
until now, avoided racing
against her
before.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
She is fascinated by Марузенски's past

performances and expresses her wish to
run
against her again someday.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Марузенски takes her words to heart
and goes
into the race with a strong
desire to inspire others
to continue
racing.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
